description: Capabilities granted to the main window. Kept minimal per tech-stack.md decision 1 (thin Rust shell): only the core defaults plus the two app-specific commands defined in src/lib.rs. Microphone capture itself goes through the webview's standard `navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia` (browser API, OS-permission-gated) — no Tauri plugin permission is required for that on desktop; this capability file exists so the seam is documented and so a future mic-related plugin (if one becomes necessary) has an obvious place to be added.
